styles.era: Letter followed by 9 digits (page styles 1 and 2 merged)
styles.notes: Page styles 1 and 2 merged: after normalization both are letter + 9 digits with year at positions 2-3 and a second pair at positions 4-5 (1-based), so they are one system, not two colliding styles. Page style 1 labels positions 4-5 'month', but its own example E072514528 yields 25 there, which is not a month and is a valid week; page style 2 labels the same positions 'week' and its example R921500600 yields week 15. The week reading is therefore the page-internal reading and ships; no month is encoded for this style.
